ci_compatibility_followup.ci_evidence: PR10 macOS Python 3.12.10 job failed in three OpenCode protocol fixture startups after roughly 25 seconds each; Codex fixture succeeded. Remote runner DNS stack was not captured.
ci_compatibility_followup.mechanism: Python 3.12 HTTPServer.server_bind invokes socket.getfqdn even for a literal loopback address; a resolver failure was reproduced deterministically. This supports the fixture reverse-DNS diagnosis without claiming a captured remote DNS timeout.
ci_compatibility_followup.fix: Test-only LoopbackServer binds through TCPServer.server_bind and sets fixed localhost/server_port; generated fixture shebang pins sys.executable. No runtime authentication behavior or readiness timeout changed.
ci_compatibility_followup.regression: test_loopback_fixture_skips_reverse_dns_and_uses_current_python injects a child-process getfqdn that raises; authenticated health and provider discovery still work and report matching parent Python major/minor.
